Cancel a subscription at its payment source, which must implement cancellations; Voidhash records
the state it answers with. Asks first; --yes skips that.

Usage:
  voidhash provider cancel-subscription [source] [flags]

Arguments:
  source  The payment source: its slug, name or id

Flags:
  -h, --help               Show help for this command
      --json               Print the API objects as JSON, for scripts
      --now                End access now instead of at the end of the paid period
      --project <project>  Project to act on: its id, slug, organization/slug or name (default: this
                           directory's project, then your default project)
  -q, --quiet              Print only ids, one per line
      --subscription <id>  The subscription's id at the source
  -y, --yes                Make the change without asking for confirmation

Global flags:
  -d, --debug              Print each request and full error detail to standard error
      --no-color           Print without colors (also when NO_COLOR is set)
      --profile <profile>  Use a named config profile: its settings override the base config
                           (default: VOIDHASH_PROFILE)

Examples:
  voidhash provider cancel-subscription paddle --subscription sub_123
  voidhash provider cancel-subscription paddle --subscription sub_123 --now --yes
